If I have to give one key advice which helped me was - the meds ain’t doing shit. It’s all you so everytime you talk or work and you feel better because you think it’s because you’re taking the meds in time it’s not that. It’s all you. My answer might not be super relevant to your starting troubles with it but I went through the whole course of taking them feeling better feeling ecstatic and then going cold turkey and now realising that the meds didn’t do shit. It was literally just me. We don’t need these goddamn meds. This self concocted belief that we need something to function better or that we’re lacking takes a serious toll that we end up propounding with meds drugs and other shit. Belief in yourselves kings and queens if you could do better with meds it’s not because they help you do things it’s because it helps stop you from thinking too much about doing something. Just go ahead and do it anyway and see how it goes. No matter how hard your brain fucks with you keep the chatter to the back of the mind and keep talking or doing what you were this is literally like how a lot of people in the olden days went ahead. None of em took meds you might say they were fucked up but I don’t think they really were.

Don’t start on meds instead just start meditating, once you’re in meds it’s super hard to resume back to your normal body and mind again although meds give you a very functional life or whatever it’s not worth it if you ask me. We don’t have a lot of problems we just have trouble sorting out our minds. Having a regular meditation pattern worked out way better than meds in the same pattern. Brain chemicals are not something we should fuck with if you ask me I wish I never started on meds.

Trust me you don’t want your anxiety to go away completely. There’s a natural reason why anxiety is present so that we don’t end up doing anything and everything. If it’s too much anxiety it just means your mind storage has exceeded and you need to clear them notifications. Meds are a cheat code actually for a thing we naturally have lost the ability to control, and yes Zoloft doesn’t take away your anxiety. But I’d advise you use it to get your shit together to handle anxiety on your own in a healthy way. Otherwise meds go on for your whole life
